scope: Current NA/Global Server Matchmaking notice revision that affects PLAYER’S CODEX PvP context; official publication evidence only, without gameplay validation

article.title: [Notice] Server Matchmaking | November 11
article.hashMethod: SHA-256 of snapshot title + newline + scripts.collect_updates.text(body)
article.comparisonLimit: The previous full notice body was not retained, so an exact row-by-row pairing-table diff is not claimed.

region: NA / Global; United States and Canada use the applicable NA East or NA West table. No KR rule is applied.

officialFact.en: The current official revision still permits Advanced Access and Launch servers to be paired, publishes separate Abyss and Spacetime Rift pairings, says pairings are periodically reevaluated, and allows same-faction Abyss matches. It lists current NA East and NA West tables.
officialFact.ko: 현재 공식 수정본은 얼리 액세스와 정식 출시 서버의 혼합 매칭, 어비스와 시공의 균열 별도 매칭표, 주기적 재평가, 동일 진영 어비스 매칭 가능성을 유지하며 북미 동부·서부의 현재 표를 게시합니다.

reason.en: Interpretation: a changed opponent table can invalidate persistent PvP matchup instructions. PLAYER’S CODEX therefore keeps the official notice as a link card and does not copy a fixed table into a guide.
reason.ko: 해석: 상대 서버 표가 바뀌면 고정 PvP 매칭 안내가 틀릴 수 있습니다. 따라서 PLAYER’S CODEX는 공식 링크 카드만 유지하고 고정 표를 공략에 복사하지 않습니다.
